purpose: Reusable Windows candidate runtime profile; not a benchmark candidate definition.
workingDirectory: The fresh local Git repository supplied to Invoke-CandidateTurn through both -C and ProcessStartInfo.WorkingDirectory.
environmentInheritance: inherit parent process environment; no secrets are serialized in harness evidence
networkExpectation: ordinary host network access inherited from the local Codex installation
dockerExpectation: candidate model turn must use the host Docker daemon itself

launcher.windowsCommandResolution: Get-Command codex -All, then select the first native Application ending in .exe
